summary: The E3 EPFL Excellence in Engineering Program is a summer 2027 research internship in engineering at EPFL in Lausanne, Switzerland. It is open to Bachelor and Master students from other universities, who must remain enrolled at their home university for the whole internship. Applicants submit a CV, transcripts, a research statement and ID.
highlights: For Bachelor and Master students enrolled at universities other than EPFL.
Summer 2027 research internship in engineering, in Lausanne.
You must stay enrolled at your home university for the whole internship.
Application needs a CV, transcripts, a research statement and ID.
